verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs advertise migration from Terraform [pulumi-docs-10], 'native support for Terraform and HCL' with HCL as a supported language [pulumi-docs-31, pulumi-docs-1], and adoption of resources created by other IaC tools via `pulumi import`, which adds them to state and generates code [pulumi-docs-17, pulumi-docs-25, pulumi-docs-21]. However, no evidence shows a documented way to convert Terraform state files directly. A hands-on user also reports that the conversion tooling (tf2pulumi) was intractable for a 40k-line multi-module codebase [pulumi-comm-9], and another cites the lack of an HCL-to-Pulumi path [pulumi-comm-13], though both reports appear dated. Missing for 10: documented direct Terraform state-file migration, detailed docs for HCL codebase conversion, and corroboration that migration works at scale for large multi-module projects.
